message.content:
Let Fresh have total price \(P_F\) and volume \(V_F\).

Fresh costs \(\$1.00\) per unit volume, so
\[
\frac{P_F}{V_F}=100\text{ cents per unit volume}.
\]

Bright is \(60\%\) more expensive than Fresh:
\[
P_B=1.6P_F.
\]

Glow is \(25\%\) less expensive than Bright:
\[
P_G=0.75P_B=0.75(1.6P_F)=1.2P_F.
\]

Glow has \(33\frac13\%\) more volume than Fresh:
\[
V_G=\frac43 V_F.
\]

Thus Glow’s cost per unit volume is
\[
\frac{P_G}{V_G}
=\frac{1.2P_F}{\frac43 V_F}
=1.2\cdot \frac34\cdot \frac{P_F}{V_F}
=0.9\cdot 100
=90
\]
cents per unit volume.

The answer is 90.
